params.body:
Four points reported from dealers on 29 September 2026, each with its cause, a fix and a test (`WhatTheDealerChoseStaysTest`, 8 tests; 6 of them fail on main).

## 1. Showroom tab says "no vehicles" for a dealer who ticks cars while adding them

The count on Settings > Showroom, the showroom link, the batches and the zip all read one query (`VehicleRepository::getForShowroom`), so the tab and the link cannot disagree: a zero on the tab means no own, unsold vehicle with `showroom_vehicle = 1` in the database. The tick got lost on the sheet. While adding a vehicle, every "Volgende" writes the step to the draft row (`saveStep` / `draftColumns`) and the sheet says "Bewaard", but `showroom_vehicle` was not in that write: it lived only in the component until "Wagen toevoegen". A dealer who stopped after the Data step, or a sheet that reloaded (refresh, reopened from the list), read the row again and got the tick off.

Fix: `draftColumns` writes the tick with every "Volgende", own vehicles only (a bidding / documents-only vehicle writes 0). The showroom has no `is_complete` check (R S2-7.8), so the car shows from the step it was ticked on. Stocklist, website and portals stay out of the draft. Vehicles that already lost their tick do not get it back.

Not verified against the dealer's rows in production; this is the only path in the code where a set tick is lost.

## 2. Body style locked after a chassis lookup (2010 VW Polo)

`ownstock/_tabs/general.blade.php` disabled the body style select while `$vehicle->category_id` (the draft row) was null. The classic sheet removed the lock in JavaScript; the Livewire sheet re-renders the field on the server, and the row only learns the category at "Volgende". When the lookup found no category, the field stayed locked after the dealer chose one, "Volgende" saved the category and refused the empty body style, and a refresh then worked. On the Livewire sheet the category on the sheet (`$category_id`) now decides; the classic sheet keeps its behaviour. PR #857 (model list) plays no role here. The report that Category itself was locked is not reproduced: that select has no lock.

## 3. Nederland Mobiel ticked by default on a new vehicle

`VehicleForm::applyNewVehicleDefaults` ticked every row of the dealer's `portals`, but Nederland Mobiel is its own link on the dealer (`dealers.nederland_mobiel`) with its own flag on the vehicle. A new own vehicle now starts with `nederland_mobiel_allowed = true` when the dealer has the link; without it the box is not on the sheet and stays off. Switching to a bidding vehicle while adding drops it (the block is hidden for that type), back to own applies it again; editing shows what is stored. `VehicleObserver` still requires the dealer link before anything is sent.

## 4. Customer mode on or off wiped the filters of the shared stock

Off did `location.reload()`, on posted the margin modal and redirected to `stocklist.index`; both opened the list as a fresh visit, and `StocklistBrowser::mount` starts clean. The switch now carries the render id (`data-list`), off reloads to the own address with `?list=<id>`, on passes the id through the margin modal and the controller redirects to the list with it, also on a refused margin. `Search::continuesList` reads a filled `list` as a continuation, and `ContinuesList` restores filters, sort and loaded cards. An unknown id is a fresh visit; a value that is not a list id is ignored.

## Business rules

- R S1-3.17 (showroom tick in the draft), R S1-3.2 (body style lock), R S2-1.18 (Nederland Mobiel in the new-vehicle defaults), R S5-1.1 (customer mode keeps the list).
- Findings: `showroomvinkje-bleef-niet-staan`, `carrosserie-bleef-op-slot`, `klantmodus-wiste-de-filters`.

## Checks

- Related suites (VehicleForm*, VehicleSheet*, Stocklist*, Showroom*, CustomerMode*, Continuation, NederlandMobiel, Rules*, QualityRatchetTest): green. `ListPageHeadersTest` fails only in a filtered run (Role 1 missing, order dependent) and passes on its own.
- PHPStan: no errors. Pint on the new test file.
- Full suite not run locally (disk).
params.title: Four points from the shop floor: showroom tick, body style lock, Nederland Mobiel default, customer mode keeps the list
